content_type_guide.GENERAL_NEWS: a standard report with no stronger signal
content_type_guide.PROBLEM_FOCUSED: about a problem, risk, failure, scam, shortage or backlash
content_type_guide.TRANSFORMATION: about a change over time, a turnaround, before versus after
content_type_guide.PRODUCT_LAUNCH: a launch, release, new feature, new scheme or new policy
content_type_guide.PERSUASIVE: a campaign, drive, sign-up or trend with evidence and a call to act
content_type_guide.BRAND_STORY: a profile of a person, founder, creator or brand
content_type_guide.LONG_FORM: a very long source text (decided by length, not by you)
content_type_guide.LISTICLE: a list, tips, ranking or roundup
content_type_guide.EXPLAINER: a how-to, what you need to know, eligibility or scheme guide
content_type_guide.FACT_BRIEF: a short factual item: announcement, result or single data point
